network_status.network: Allerta meteo per temporali e piogge diffuse del 4 ottobre 2021
network_status.summary_it: L'aggiornamento ARPAL documenta gli innalzamenti nelle sezioni strumentate del Centro-Ponente, in particolare Letimbro e Bormida di Spigno, ma non pubblica una misura sul torrente Quazzola a Quiliano. I livelli degli altri corsi d'acqua non vengono trasferiti al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAL update documents rises at instrumented central-western Ligurian sections, particularly the Letimbro and Bormida di Spigno, but publishes no Quazzola stream measurement at Quiliano. Levels from other watercourses are not transferred to the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
